trust_decision.summary: Per-route FastAPI dependency decides whether the caller's remote-role may read operational data that carries secrets (raw log files, process cmdlines, stats history); at the pinned commit /logs and /stats* use allow_any_authenticated, so any viewer passes.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'viewer can read logs'; /logs/{service} is the only log-reading route and is gated by allow_any_authenticated; the admin password is written to the frigate log at first start (frigate/app.py:545, :563).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second log-reading helper (e.g. a per-camera ffmpeg log download) behind allow_any_authenticated.
